svg.title: Clearway pipeline: XProtect cameras → change detector + YOLO11m → SigLIP 2 → incident memory → Hafnia VLM → one incident
svg.text: Every Hafnia request is earned: notice a lasting change, fingerprint it, ask only about what is new, raise one incident.
danger zone: feet on tracks ≥ 1 s
• whole-view changes (light, fog) are not objects
• a lasting change does not fade into the background
• YOLO and SigLIP share one GPU behind a lock
• runs on every camera, costs no request
• part of an open incident → joins it
• rejected here → held; asked after 30 s
• spot clears → alarm closes after 60 s
Event clip, cropped to the spot
2 s before → 3 s after · lens would enlarge ≥ 2.5×?
NONE → remembered as rejected here; the detector releases the spot
Operator Confirm / Reject → teaches the incident memory

g.text: asking every camera once a minute: 60 / camera-hour,
the daily 500 gone in 45 min, person on tracks 0 of 6
7 incidents, cards 20–42 s after the change
direct ask on a large spot, 6 of 6 right;
